title: On the Information Loss of Multi-Token Prediction: Origin and Solution
abstract: arXiv:2611.31966v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) accelerates autoregressive decoding through block-wise prediction, but remains vulnerable to error accumulation across sequentially generated blocks. To investigate this limitation, we analyze the distinction between block-wise and sequence-level cumulative information loss (CIL). Specifically, when the model generates using its own previous outputs without access to reference answers, the input-conditional gap equals the cross-block dependence of the reference targets. To improve prediction when these generated prefixes are imperfect, we propose Dual-MTP, which supervises shared prediction heads under full and randomly masked contexts. Together, complete-prefix supervision and context perturbations provide complementary training signals while retaining the MTP architecture. translated_title: 多词元预测中的信息损失：成因与解决方案
translated_abstract: 多词元预测通过分块预测加速自回归解码，但在按顺序生成各块的过程中仍容易受到误差累积的影响。为研究这一局限性，我们分析了分块级别与序列级别累积信息损失（CIL）之间的区别。具体而言，当模型使用其自身先前的输出进行生成而无法访问参考答案时，输入条件下的差距等于参考目标之间的跨块依赖性。为了在这些生成前缀不完美的情况下改进预测，我们提出了Dual-MTP，它在完整上下文和随机掩码上下文下对共享预测头进行监督。完整前缀监督与上下文扰动共同提供了互补的训练信号，同时保留了MTP架构。为了刻画这一训练目标，我们使用归一化双重损失来约束模型预测分布之间的散度……
tldr: 该论文揭示了多词元预测中误差累积源于参考目标间的跨块依赖性，并提出Dual-MTP方法，通过在完整与随机掩码上下文下双重监督共享预测头来缓解信息损失。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies cross-block dependence as the origin of information loss in multi-token prediction (MTP) and proposes Dual-MTP, which supervises shared prediction heads under both full and randomly masked contexts to mitigate error accumulation.
